method: Independent ordinary play through visible-driver CLI only; handbook and visible screenshots/HUD. No source, repository documentation, hidden state, tests, hooks, route lookup or autoaim. Runtime untouched.

gameplay.reason: Optic kills and Shift breaks produce a useful skill loop; second attempt improved to two critical eliminations and one disabled coil. Dense overlapping fire punished standing still severely. My misses and choice to bypass patrols contributed to both losses.

presentation.reason: Strong coherent cyan/amber rainy industrial atmosphere, striking relay ring and polished title/end typography. Boxy repeated architecture, simple enemies and sparse spaces remain visibly modest in scope.

usability.reason: Persistent controls, objective distance, recovery ring prompts and paused facility map helped. Handbook is lengthy; I repeatedly misjudged receiver reach and became stuck navigating the west room corner before using the map.

readability.reason: Critical optic shapes, roman coil plates and offscreen charge warnings are legible. Small world labels and crowded overlapping HUD warnings compete during firefights; a selected objective behind cover still required deliberate map interpretation.

aaaReadiness.reason: A coherent playable slice with a complete loss/retry flow, but observed geometry/enemy variety and combat communication do not meet a broad AAA polish expectation. No extraction victory, audio, performance benchmark or full content breadth validated.

replayability.reason: Second run supported learning routes and optic/Shift timing; the small fixed three-memory mission offers limited observed variety. Two attempts cannot establish lasting replay value.

outcomes.notes: Multiple aiming misses, premature E presses, low-cover collisions and navigation reversals retained. Reached Custodian without destroying coils.

outcomes.lastObservedCoils: I OFF; II 100%; III 100% at sequence 52; died during next firing action, final remaining coil health unobserved
outcomes.notes: Killed Heart Warden after Shift and optic adjustment. Sprint approached Custodian; destroyed coil I, then died while reloading/aiming at another. No arranged deaths or outcomes.

objectiveSelection.detail: Clicked visible Mara and Sera buttons; both already matched current selected objective, so no evidence of selecting an alternate-order target.

optionalTrace.detail: Held Tab while moving; ground chevrons visibly shown in first two evidence images. Not every held capture visibly showed chevrons; no inference of absence of feature from those.

findings.observation: Map pauses mission and clearly identifies room walls and recovery points. It resolved my west-room corner snag.
Low cover blocked straightforward movement; near receiver still needed a smaller adjustment inside floor ring. Clear MOVE CLOSER prompt helped.
Custodian plates and three health cells made one disabled coil easy to confirm; dark spent coil contrasted copper live coils.
Loss flow preserved recovered identities and provided concise accuracy/critical/evade results and immediate retry.

preservation: All 53 capture commands, controls, misses and both deaths remain in raw driver actions and JPEGs; no commands/errors removed. CLI help and process verification are recorded in this review summary. No driver pageErrors reported; no CLI command errors during play. ps exit 1 with empty output intentionally establishes absence.

limits.graphics: Driver reported Software-WebGL fallback enabled; renderer not certified. Screenshots show appearance only, not native-GPU quality or smoothness. Some command releases took seconds; HUD can precede screenshot and heading updates, so not treated as a camera defect.
limits.audio: No audible output available through this screenshot/text workflow; audio unassessed.
limits.human: Agent using sequential JSON actions and still screenshots, not continuous human mouse/keyboard play. Aiming overshoots and poor accuracy materially limited combat. No extraction or victory observed; cannot rate upload execution.
